parallels.note: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: It shall be for a sign on your hand, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of hand Yahweh brought us out of Egypt.”
translations.bsb: So it shall serve as a sign on your hand and a symbol on your forehead, for with a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt.”
translations.kjv: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.
translations.asv: And it shall be for a sign upon thy hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand Jehovah brought us forth out of Egypt.
